title: Operators
intro: Learn the basic ideas of Operators in simple English. Read the explanation and example first; the quiz asks only from the concepts taught here.

items.heading: Arithmetic operators
items.text: Arithmetic operators perform calculations. Common ones include +, -, *, /, //, %, and **.

items.heading: Equality (==)
items.text: == compares two values and produces True when they are equal.

items.heading: Not equal (!=)
items.text: != checks whether two values are different.

items.heading: Floor division (//)
items.text: // divides and keeps the floor of the result for numbers such as 10 and 3.

items.heading: Exponent (**)
items.text: ** raises a number to a power.

items.heading: Logical and
items.text: and is True only when both combined conditions are true.

items.heading: Logical or
items.text: or is True when at least one combined condition is true.

items.heading: Assignment (=)
items.text: = assigns a value to a variable. It is different from ==, which compares values.

items.heading: Operator precedence
items.text: Some operators are evaluated before others. Multiplication normally comes before addition.
